opus.w: This section only extends the Food and Agriculture Act of 1965 by replacing year references (for example, "through 1969" becomes "through 1970"). It names no outside party and creates no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue. The possibility that the extended Act has its own procedures elsewhere is not enough, because nothing in this text brings outsiders into a federal decision.
opus.b: 1. **Thinking it through.** One tempting reading is that extending the Food and Agriculture Act of 1965 also extends whatever programs are in that Act, which might include producer referenda or regulations. That fails because this section only swaps dates in the existing text. It names no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. Producer referenda, even if the underlying Act has them, are listed in the definition as not counting.

qwen_chat.w: This section solely extends the expiration dates of the Food and Agriculture Act of 1965 by substituting later years for earlier ones. It does not create, require, or describe any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with outside parties. It is a technical amendment regarding the temporal scope of the statute.
qwen_chat.s: That the Food and Agriculture Act of 1965 is extended— (1) by striking out “through 1969” wherever it appears and substituting “through 1970”; (2) by striking out “1966, 1967, 1968, and 1969” wherever it. appears and substituting “1966 through 1970”; (3) by striking out “1969” in sections 103 and 201 and substituting “1970”; (4) by striking out “1967, 1968, and 1969” in section 402(b) and substituting “1967 through 1970”; (5) by striking out “1970” in section 404 and substituting (6) by striking out “1966 through the 1969” in section 516 and substituting “1966 through the 1970”; (7) by striking out “1968” and “1969” wherever they appear in section 602(k) and substituting “1969” and “1970”, respectively; and (8) by striking out “or 1969” in section 801 and substituting “1969, or 1970”.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that extending the Act implies continuing existing participation mechanisms within that Act. However, this specific section only amends dates and does not itself establish, require, or describe any participation process. It is purely a technical amendment to extend the duration of the statute.
